title: Promptable segmentation models
description: 8 promptable segmentation models. Each section says what the model is, whether it may be used commercially and how fast it is; licences and checks are under Details.
html:
8 promptable segmentation models. Each section says what the model is, whether it may be used commercially and how fast it is; licences and checks are under Details.

Input: one image plus a point, box or text prompt. Output: masks with quality scores.

Measured on RTX 5060 Ti, torch 2.14.1+cu130; fastforks bench MODEL --size HxW measures yours. The summary uses one input, 1024x1024: kernels time with its speed-up over the faster original run, and kernels peak reserved memory with its ratio to the smaller original one. Where measured (one variant per family), a variant's table also lists portable under torch.compile and the fp16 TensorRT engine of portable (export; memory: the engine's device memory). – = not measured.

Other devices: Apple M1 Pro 16 GB, NVIDIA L4, NVIDIA L40S, NVIDIA A10, NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB, NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000; across devices.
